AI Research Capability Forecasting
Define objective to forecast frontier agent AI R&D capabilities
Target realistic open-ended machine learning workflows

Task Rigor & Scope Criteria
Require realism, full executability, and measurable progress
Calibrate to approximately eight-hour human expert horizon

Candidate Task Brainstorming
Propose candidate ML engineering & empirical research problems
Span optimization, hyperparameter search, and architectures

Formal Task Specification
Write rigorous instructions, deliverables, and resource constraints
Draft standard task specifications per candidate

Isolated Environment Construction
Build secure containerized execution environments
Ensure strict conformance with METR Task Standard

Continuous Scoring Function Design
Implement granular metric functions to detect minor gains
Avoid binary all-or-nothing evaluation pitfalls

Baseline Starting Solution
Author reproducible minimal baseline code
Anchor starting score definitionally at 0.0

Expert Reference Solution
Develop highly optimized reference solution
Anchor reference score at 1.0 while allowing higher

Pilot Verification & Pruning
Execute test runs to inspect score variance and feasibility
Iteratively refine prompts or discard fragile tasks

RE-Bench v1 Benchmark Freeze
Freeze 7 diverse hand-crafted ML research environments
Span LLM fine-tuning, RL, vision, and interpretability

Human Expert Baseline Collection
Conduct 71 supervised 8-hour attempts across 61 ML experts
Establish definitive human baseline trajectory data

Time-Bounded Agent Evaluation
Deploy autonomous research agents into identical environments
Enforce strict compute budgets and tool limits

Normalized Performance Scaling
Scale artifact scores with baseline at 0 and reference at 1
Preserve unbounded scores for superhuman breakthroughs

Score@k Metric Aggregation
Aggregate best-of-k trials across multiple random seeds
Quantify empirical scaling law and capability horizon
